_about: Copy to glass-settings.json (beside living.html, not in git) and change what you like; anything left out keeps its default. Hours are 0-23 local time, temperatures °F from the weather station, lengths in minutes; circleOrder is who sits where at the campfire circle, left to right; views (48, 32 or 24), smoothing and campfire (the group's campfire circle after dark) are for a smaller GPU (a travel glass on a laptop: 32, false and false). Relaunch the glass to apply.
